summary.text: David Sutman Jr., an independent, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in Tennessee to Bill Hagerty.
He describes himself as a working-class Tennessean and political outsider, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a truck driver.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Sutman's career experience as working as a truck driver.

He describes himself as a working-class Tennessean who was raised with values of hard work, personal responsibility and community, and says he has spent his career "solving real-world problems" and creating opportunities rather than navigating political circles.
During the campaign, he said he was running to focus on cost-of-living issues and government accountability.
He received 0.1% of the vote to Bill Hagerty's 55.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
